data.name: Iqtiyar
data.gender_notes: Iqtiyar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Iqtiyar is derived from the Arabic word ‘iqtar’, which means to catch, to grasp, or to seize. In the Islamic context, the name Iqtiyar symbolizes the concept of seizing opportunities and being grateful for the blessings of Allah (swt). The Quran states, ‘And whoever is saved from the covetousness of his soul, it is they who will be the successful.’ (Quran 59:9). Thus, the name Iqtiyar is a reminder to always be mindful of Allah’s blessings and to seize every opportunity to do good and please Him.
data.spiritual_meaning: Seizing opportunities to do good and please Allah (swt).
data.etymology: Iqtiyar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Opportunity, Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iqtiyar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
